Chapter 883: Chapter 20 Is This It? (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 883: Chapter 20 Is this it? (Please subscribe)

After repeated negotiations.

Finally, the ten peak clans decided to each gather a hundred Level Eleven Perfect experts, using one-tenth of their life essence as a pivot point to balance and exchange for the corresponding life essence of the Galaxy Master.

As for the Yu Clan… The Yu Clan’s precious artifact ‘Balance Scale’ was provided, so they naturally did not need to offer the life essence of their Level Eleven Perfect experts.

Besides the Yu Clan, the Robber Clan did not offer many Level Eleven Perfect experts either.

The population of the Robber Clan has always been sparse, and the importance of any Level Eleven Perfect expert from the Robber Clan far exceeds those from other clans.

The Robber Clan did not offer much in terms of Level Eleven Perfect life essence, but the strongest Level Eleven of the Robber Clan promised to use more hidden cards when surrounding and attacking the Galaxy Master, compensating for the losses of the other peak clans.

For this reason, although the Tianyu Clan and the Insect Race had some complaints, there was nothing they could do; the strength of the Robber Clan was too formidable, and the facts were set.

It was not realistic to expect the Robber Clan to share the number of Level Eleven Perfect experts.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, ten years passed.

Somewhere in the stars.

Fan Gaomo was hovering over a golden scale.

A hundred Level Eleven Perfect experts from various peak clan forces appeared slightly weak, their figures faintly emitting an ethereal aura, all gathered on the left side of the golden scale.

This ethereal aura faintly had weight, causing the golden scale to start tilting towards the left.

“Enter the super-large battlefield immediately.”

Fan Gaomo put away the golden scale.

The life essence given by the hundred Level Eleven Perfect experts and the gathered ethereal air on the left side of the Balance Scale could not last long.

They must quickly enter the super-large battlefield, lock onto the aura of the Galaxy Master, and proceed with a forced exchange.

Swoosh.

Fan Gaomo’s figure disappeared.

With the push of the Yu Clan’s strongest, he arrived near the super-large battlefield and descended into the peripheral area.

“This distance should be enough.”

Fan Gaomo did not enter the core area through the Space-Time Path, as that would be too dangerous.

With the power of the Balance Scale, even being in the peripheral area, he could lock onto the aura of the Galaxy Master.

“They should all be ready.”

Fan Gaomo looked towards the core area battlefield.

Over the past ten years, the various peak clans stealthily sent strong fighters to re-enter the super-large battlefield.

Of course, they mostly wandered in the peripheral areas, not daring to delve too deeply to avoid being sensed by the Galaxy Master and pursued again.

With this continuous effort, the strongest Level Eleven of the various peak clans also received great support, just waiting for Fan Gaomo to significantly weaken the life essence of the Galaxy Master.

Then they would join forces to counterattack the Human Civilization Alliance and avenge the humiliation suffered over these ten years.

“Begin.”

Fan Gaomo immediately activated the Balance Scale, and his perception began to exponentially expand.

With the life essence gathered at the left end of the scale, Fan Gaomo could easily feel all life essence within thousands of light-years.

Of course, he could only feel the life essence.

The scale of life essence was not within the scope.

The Balance Scale did not have that capability; it only handled the exchange of corresponding items.

Whether the item existed or how much there was, it did not particularly care.

In a trance, Fan Gaomo faintly felt a familiar yet fearful life essence aura in the center of the core area battlefield.

“Is that the Galaxy Master?”

Fan Gaomo immediately confirmed, even though he had only met the Galaxy Master once, the impact of that encounter was incredibly profound.

Tens of thousands of Level Eleven experts were annihilated, and hundreds of powerful artifacts lost, leaving Fan Gaomo with a deep psychological scar.

Had it not been for the Balance Scale’s treasure, Fan Gaomo doubted he would have the courage to confront the Galaxy Master.

So…

Fan Gaomo could definitely not forget the life essence aura of the Galaxy Master.

“Lock on.”

Fan Gaomo was excited inside and immediately used the Balance Scale to lock onto the aura of the Galaxy Master.

“Establish connection.”

“It will take no more than two hours to proceed with the exchange.”

Fan Gaomo thought to himself, the capability of the Balance Scale was indeed incredible, but it also required time to ferment.

To force an exchange, it took time to establish a connection between the two sides of the scale.

But the waiting time here was not long, just about two hours, and Fan Gaomo could wait.

…

At the center of the Victory Altar.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged.

After ten years of hard cultivation, Lin Yuan had sequentially gained insights into twelve Pillar-level Fusion Rules, advancing to the Seventh Realm.

It is important to note that the Seventh Realm of Pillar-level Fusion Rule comprehension is a level that only Level Twelve experts could reach.

In just a short ten years, Lin Yuan had stepped into this level, and that too with ten Pillar-level Fusion Rules.

This was far more efficient compared to the several hundred years spent laboriously advancing the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule to the Sixth Realm.

Firstly, the Seventh Realm of Pillar-level Fusion Rules is much easier than the Sixth Realm of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

Secondly, Lin Yuan had already stepped into this domain, using space-time to drive other Pillar-level Fusion Rules made it much easier.

“Space-time…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes were deep, faintly with the ‘Milky Way’ of space-time rippling around.

Over the past ten years, Lin Yuan had devoted a considerable part of his energy to the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

Although he felt himself making progress in his understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule every moment, he had not yet reached the peak of the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm.

“Ten years is still too short.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

If it were a hundred or a thousand years, he might have reached the peak of the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm.

Just as Lin Yuan was about to continue exploring the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

An inexplicable sensation of being watched and targeted emerged out of nowhere, subtly beginning to connect with Lin Yuan.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan was startled and immediately realized that this was very likely a precursor to a counterattack by the eleven great pinnacle clan forces.

“This sense of being watched and targeted… I have no idea where it’s coming from.”

Lin Yuan looked serious, able to feel the sensations of being watched and targeted thanks to his strong mental will, but unable to determine their specific origin.

“As expected.”

“The eleven great pinnacle clan forces are not to be underestimated.”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew solemn, trying to study the sense of being watched surrounding him, but to no avail.

“However, I have already sent all the supreme weapons and treasures to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, so even if the Taiyang Primordial Spirit dies, the loss won’t be significant.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze quickly settled.

Furthermore, Lin Yuan had also made preparations for facing extreme situations, having already had Xia Qin, a supreme being, take his Taiyin Primordial Spirit near a huge battlefield.

Once the Taiyang Primordial Spirit perishes, the true self will regenerate the Taiyang Primordial Spirit, and during this time, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit would directly descend onto the battlefield.

“I can form the two Primordial Spirits much easier than forming an incarnation. Alternating between Taiyang and Taiyin, I don’t believe I can’t protect the altar.”

Lin Yuan silently thought to himself, already prepared for the possibility of both primordial spirits falling several times.

…

Two hours later.

On the edge region, Fan Gaomo sat there, waiting for the balance scale to establish a complete connection with the Galaxy Master.

At that moment.

Fan Gaomo’s eyes sharpened, controlling the balance scale, he had already detected a stable connection with the Galaxy Master.

Following this stable connection, the balance scale could execute a forced exchange.

“Exchange.”

Fan Gaomo was impatient, activating the balance scale, exchanging with the Galaxy Master for the life essence equivalent to the void essence formed at the left end of the scale.

Buzz buzz buzz~

In front of Fan Gaomo, the golden balance scale, originally heavier on the left due to carrying the void essence, started to tip.

But now, as the exchange started, strands of void essence began to appear on the right, increasing in number and causing the right side to also begin descending until the balance scale subtly achieved equilibrium, the weights equal.

“It’s done.”

“The life essence of the Galaxy Master has been exchanged away.”

A smile appeared on Fan Gaomo’s face, the void essence condensed on the right end of the scale representing the life essence of the Galaxy Master.

The amount of life essence is roughly equivalent to four or five times that of a normal Level Eleven Perfect.

“The counterattack has begun.”

Fan Gaomo straightened up, faintly guessing that at this moment, the Galaxy Master must be terrified, having discovered a significant drop in his life essence.

With this thought.

Fan Gaomo immediately started contacting the rest of the ten peak Level Eleventh.

For ten years, these Level Eleven Perfects had been waiting for this moment, for the Galaxy Master to fall into unprecedented weakness, and then seize this opportunity to reclaim everything lost ten years ago.

…

In the deepest part of the altar.

Lin Yuan was still trying to trace the source of the sensation of being watched and targeted. Although his mental will had fully stepped into the twelfth tier and was relatively strong at this level, his realm had ultimately not kept up.

Thus, he could only sense the feelings of being watched and targeted, but could not discern their specific source.

In fact, for a normal Level Eleven Perfect life form, it wouldn’t even be possible to sense such feelings of surveillance and targeting.

“What kind of method is this?”

Lin Yuan was on high alert, aware that the counterattack from the eleven great pinnacle clans had begun.

From the looks of it, his side seemed to be at a disadvantage, not even knowing which method the opponent was using.

As Lin Yuan waited.

He suddenly discovered that his life essence was slowly decreasing.

“My life essence is diminishing?”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew grave; life essence is fundamental to any life form, and its reduction is detrimental.

Although Lin Yuan could feel that the rate of decrease in his life essence was incredibly slow, barely noticeable compared to his massive life essence unless closely monitored.

But a decrease was still a decrease. With the means of the eleven great pinnacle clans, this might just be the beginning.

Soon.

After about a dozen breaths.

Lin Yuan’s reduction in life essence rapidly stopped.

“Hmm?”

“That’s it?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat stunned, initially thinking that the rate of life essence decline would accelerate, but it ended so quickly?

Lin Yuan examined himself, compared to just over a dozen breaths before.

His life essence had decreased by perhaps one ten-millionth?
